after5_start.name: {name}
after5_start.text: *The event is winding down. In the hall, I run into the two people I didn't choose.*

after5_farewell_seo_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_1.text: *I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_3.text: *She tucks loose hair behind her ear and readjusts her grip on her bag strap.*

after5_farewell_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_4.text: Well, I expected it. I just don't want it to look like I was the one who gave up first.

after5_farewell_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6.text: If that's your decision, I'll respect it. That doesn't mean I've sorted out my own feelings.

after5_farewell_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6_b.text: *She turns away and waves. She does not look back. Only the ribbon at her wrist sways at the end of the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_7.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_7.text: *I'm left alone in the hall. Seoyeon's footsteps fade, and somewhere upstairs, the rooftop door locks.*

after5_farewell_yuna_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_1.text: *Yuna approaches in front of the library. Without a word, she hands me a book.*

after5_farewell_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_2.text: *A bookmark is tucked inside. A single line on the bookmark.*

after5_farewell_yuna_3.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_3.text: Don't be late for the person you chose. ...I still like you, though.

after5_farewell_yuna_4.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_4.text: *She turns down the hall toward the library. The sound of her shoes disappears around the corner.*

after5_farewell_yuna_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_5.text: *Only one line is written on the bookmark: 'It was fun.' It ends with a period.*

after5_farewell_dain_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_1.text: *Dain walks over from the gym. Her steps are shorter than usual.*

after5_farewell_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_2.text: Tch, that stings! But I'm not backing off just because I'm disappointed.

after5_farewell_dain_4.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4.text: I know who you chose. I still like you, though. I'm allowed to say that much.

after5_farewell_dain_4_b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_b.text: *Dain gives my shoulder a light punch.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_c.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_c.text: Treat her right. If you don't, I'm taking you back.

after5_farewell_dain_4_d.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_d.text: *She pushes the volleyball into the rack and readjusts the strap of her knee brace.*

after5_farewell_dain_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5.text: *Dain tightens the strap of her knee brace once more and goes into the gym.*

after5_farewell_dain_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5b.text: *I leave the gym and head toward the back of the school.*

after5_hidden_farewell_1.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_1.text: *At the school gate, Seoyeon checks the event roster with Haeun, Dain shortens her stride with a volleyball under one arm, and Yuna lowers her eyes to an open book. Each heads for a different exit.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3.text: *At the gate, I raise one hand in farewell.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3b.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3b.text: *I walk toward the back of the school.*

after5_sunset_1.name: {name}
after5_sunset_1.text: *Sunset catches on every classroom window. The broadcast room announces the event's end, and the field speakers crackle a beat behind.*

after5_hidden_route_choice_check.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice_check.text: *The path to meet my friends and the path back to help finish the event split here.*

after5_hidden_route_choice.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice.text: *I leave the remaining event cleanup to the other students and head for the park where my friends are waiting.*

after5_last_chance_1.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_1.text: *The event speakers power down. Beneath the fork-in-the-road sign, the toes of my shoes remain unable to choose a direction.*

after5_last_chance_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2.text: *I take the phone from my pocket. Only the event banner is reflected in its black screen.*

after5_last_chance_2_b.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_b.text: *Without turning on the phone, I put it back in my pocket. I take two steps toward the other side of the fork and call her name.*

after5_last_chance_2_d.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_d.text: *Seoyeon turns around. The event banner behind her folds once in the wind.*

after5_last_chance_2_f.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_f.text: *Seoyeon winds the end of her student council ribbon around one finger, then lets it go.*

after5_last_chance_2_g.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_g.text: I'll talk. Just stay for a minute.

after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.text: *She looks back, one foot still half pointed toward the exit.* Why?

after5_last_chance_2_l.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_l.text: *She takes one step past me, then pins the floor with the volleyball and stops.*

after5_last_chance_2_n.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_n.text: *The arm holding the ball drops from her side. The toe of her sneaker turns back toward {name}.*

after5_last_chance_2_p.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_p.text: *She bites her lip once and takes a short breath.*

after5_last_chance_2_q.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_q.text: I've been waiting since yesterday. But I can't just smile right away.

after5_last_chance_2_r.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_r.text: *She rubs the corner of her eye. Her smile stays the same, but moisture clings to the back of her hand.*

after5_last_chance_2_s.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_s.text: Say it. I'll listen to the end.

after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.text: *She comes back after taking one step too far. Holding the volleyball against her chest, she keeps her distance.* Why?

after5_last_chance_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_2.text: *She stops. She hugs the book to her chest. It takes about two seconds for her to turn around.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_4.text: *Two steps remain between us. Yuna waits with the book against her chest.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_5.text: I'll listen before I go. Even if I can't say it's okay.

after5_last_chance_yuna_6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_6.text: *Yuna doesn't look away. The distance between us has narrowed by one step.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_7.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_7.text: *She waits, holding the book. The reply window still has no first letter.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.text: *She looks back between the shelves, her arms tightening around the book.* Why?

after5_last_chance_choice.name: {name}
choices: Let us both take some time to think.

after5_confess_yes.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes.text: *I put the phone in my pocket and call her name.*

after5_confess_yes_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes_2.text: Hey — there's something I need to say.

after5_confess_react_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo.text: *We start walking side by side toward the park.* You're late. But I'll listen.

after5_confess_react_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo_low.text: *She says nothing until the crosswalk signal changes once.* I heard you. That's enough for now.

after5_confess_react_dain.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain.text: *As we leave school, she glances once at her shoelaces.* Hey, you. I did wait. Say everything you came to say.

after5_confess_react_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain_low.text: *Her thumb traces a groove in the volleyball.* I heard you. But I can't smile right away yet.

after5_confess_react_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna.text: *We walk side by side.* I already knew. But I'll listen.

after5_confess_react_yuna_b.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_b.text: *She sets down her book. Her hands are trembling.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_c.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_c.text: I still wanted to hear you say it.

after5_confess_react_yuna_d.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_d.text: *She hands me a folded note. When I unfold it, there is a single line.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_f.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_f.text: *One letter is pressed hard into the page. The paper bears the creases of being folded and unfolded over and over.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_g.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_g.text: If you read it, that's enough.

after5_confess_react_yuna_h.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_h.text: *We walked side by side. In silence.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_i.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_i.text: *And so — we walked beyond the school.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_low.text: *She folds the note in her hand.* I read it. But I still can't decide on the ending.

after5_confess_fail_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_1.text: *No more words came. As the sun sank lower, we just walked in the same direction for a while.*

after5_confess_fail_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_2.text: *Without reaching an answer, we walk toward the park.*

after5_confess_no.name: {name}
after5_confess_no.text: *I turn off the phone screen and press my lips together.*

after5_confess_no_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2.text: *The evening breeze rolls an event flyer to my feet. I pick it up and tuck it beneath the bulletin board.*

after5_set_harem.name: {name}
after5_set_harem.text: *The words I folded away at lunch remain. Three message threads light up at once, and I can't type the first letter in any of them.*

after5_harem_commit.name: {name}
after5_harem_commit.text: *After switching among all three chats, I lower the phone. “I couldn't choose one person.” All three gazes move from the screen to {name}.*

after5_harem_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_1.text: *None of us could speak first as we left the back of the school.*

after5_harem_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_2.text: *Unanswered messages remain on my lock screen. My feet turn toward the park.*

after5_defer_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_defer_seo.text: *She slowly lowers her open hand.* Fine. If that is what you decided.

after5_defer_dain.name: Dain
after5_defer_dain.text: *She hugs the volleyball to her chest again.* ...Fine. Even though I was the one waiting.

after5_defer_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_defer_yuna.text: *She pulls the book back to her chest.* Okay. Even though you were the one who asked me to wait.
